notes.content:
[p]Hello! We continue to regularly share news about the development of Xenolocus[/p][p]The player is a space marine on an alien base that serves as a refuge for those fighting to survive.[/p][p]Player’s tasks:[/p][p]·        Gather resources to sustain the base[/p][p]·        Rescue squads caught in difficult situations[/p][p]·        Track down the most dangerous enemies attacking the base’s inhabitants[/p][p]·        Conduct research expeditions into the most dangerous areas[/p][p]·        Search for artifacts that reveal the secrets of an ancient alien civilization[/p][p][/p][p]Follow our news, subscribe to our social networks and add the game to your wishlist so as not to miss anything.[/p][p]
